subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Extended Producer Responsibility
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Extended Producer Responsibility.

hook.text: You made the product. Now you're legally responsible for what happens when the customer throws it away.

buildup.text: EPR laws make producers financially responsible for the end-of-life treatment of their products.

discovery.text: Companies must fund collection, recycling, and disposal. This incentivizes designing products for recyclability.

twist.text: EPR shifts cost from taxpayers to producers. Industries that lobbied against it now must redesign packaging.

climax.text: EPR laws exist in 130+ countries, covering electronics, packaging, batteries, and textiles.

punchline.text: You made it. You own its entire lifecycle. That's EPR.

quiz.question: What does EPR make producers responsible for?
